info.title: RaceDay API
info.description: Call POST /api/auth/login first. The session cookie it sets is reused by Swagger for every protected endpoint.

post.description: Creates an Organiser or Participant account. Expects fullName, email, password (minimum 8 characters), role (Organiser or Participant) and optionally phoneNumber and clubId. Returns 201 with the new user, 400 for invalid data or an unknown club, or 409 if the email is already registered.

post.summary: Log in and start a session
post.description: Checks the credentials and starts a server-side session that stores the user id and role. Expects email and password. Returns 200 with the user's details and sets the session cookie, or 401 for invalid credentials. Log in here first before testing protected endpoints.
Ends the current session. Expects no body. Returns 204, or 401 if nobody is logged in.

get.description: Public. Returns the categories (such as 10km, 21km or Under 20) defined for the event. Returns 200 with the list, or 404 if the event does not exist.

post.summary: Add a category to an event
post.description: Organiser only, and only the owning Organiser. Expects categoryName, minAge, maxParticipants and entryFee. Returns 201 with the category, 400 for invalid data or a duplicate name, 401, 403 if not the owner, or 404 if the event does not exist.

put.description: Organiser only, and only the Organiser who owns the event. Expects categoryName, minAge, maxParticipants and entryFee. Returns 200 with the category, 400 for invalid data or a duplicate name, 401, 403, or 404 if the category does not exist.

delete.description: Organiser only, and only the Organiser who owns the event. Expects no body. Returns 204, 401, 403, 404 if the category does not exist, or 409 if participants are enrolled in it.

post.description: Participant only. Expects categoryId for a category of this event. Records the link between the logged-in Participant, the event and the category. Returns 201 with the enrolment, 400 if the category belongs to another event, 401, 403 if not a Participant, 404 if the event or category does not exist, or 409 if already enrolled or the category is full.

get.summary: View all enrolments for an event
get.description: Organiser only, and only the owning Organiser. Returns every Participant enrolled in the event. Returns 200 with the list, 401, 403 if not the owner, or 404 if the event does not exist.
Participant only. Returns every event the logged-in Participant has entered, with the chosen category. Returns 200 with the list, 401, or 403 if not a Participant.

delete.description: Participant only, and only for their own enrolment. Any captured result for it is removed too. Returns 204, 401, 403 if it is not their enrolment, or 404 if it does not exist.

get.description: Public. Returns all events dated today or later, soonest first. Expects no body. Returns 200 with the list of events.

post.description: Organiser only. Expects eventName, description, eventDate, location, distance and eventType (Running, Walking or Cycling). The logged-in Organiser becomes the owner. Returns 201 with the event, 400 for invalid data, 401 if not logged in, or 403 if not an Organiser.

get.description: Organiser only. Returns every event the logged-in Organiser created, including past events, soonest first. Expects no body. Returns 200 with the list, 401 if not logged in, or 403 if not an Organiser.
Public. Returns the full details of the event with the given id. Returns 200 with the event, or 404 if it does not exist.

put.description: Organiser only, and only the Organiser who owns the event. Expects the same fields as creating an event. Returns 200 with the updated event, 400 for invalid data, 401, 403 if not the owner, or 404 if the event does not exist.

delete.description: Organiser only, and only the owning Organiser. Also removes the event's categories, enrolments and results. Expects no body. Returns 204, 401, 403 if not the owner, or 404 if the event does not exist.

post.description: Organiser only, and only the owning Organiser. Expects a multipart form with an image in the field named file (JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP, up to 5 MB). The image is stored in Azure Blob Storage and its URL saved on the event. Returns 200 with the imageUrl, 400 for a missing or invalid image, 401, 403 if not the owner, or 404 if the event does not exist.

Organiser only, and only for events they own. Expects finishTime (hh:mm:ss) and position. Returns 201 with the result, 400 for invalid data, 401, 403 if not the event owner, 404 if the enrolment does not exist, or 409 if a result was already captured.

get.description: Participant only. Returns the logged-in Participant's finish times and positions across all events, newest event first. Returns 200 with the list, 401, or 403 if not a Participant.
Any logged-in user. Returns all captured results for the event ordered by finishing position. Returns 200 with the list, 401 if not logged in, or 404 if the event does not exist.
Returns the profile of the logged-in user (either role). Expects no body. Returns 200 with the profile, or 401 if not logged in.

put.description: Updates the logged-in user's fullName, phoneNumber and clubId. Returns 200 with the updated profile, 400 for invalid data or an unknown club, or 401 if not logged in.

post.description: Any logged-in user. Expects a multipart form with an image in the field named file (JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP, up to 5 MB). The image is stored in Azure Blob Storage and its URL saved on the profile. Returns 200 with the imageUrl, 400 for a missing or invalid image, or 401 if not logged in.
